maria: CI flagged a 6-10% 99th tail regression in nightly matmul-quant on p4s. looks thermal. :eyes:
kevin: which workload?
maria: seq128 batch1 microbench, logs in CI artifact.
deploy-bot: preflight: runtime-v2.14.7-quant status=unstable (perf-telemetry failing).
nana: ana here 30 eviction spikes when GPUs throttle. likely kernel scheduling change.
kevin: repros if I switch to new matmul kernel locally. planning hotpatch to pick legacy path via env flag.
tom: QA can reproduce in staging under 10m sustained load; filing RN-471.
maria: rollout plan: freeze, pin night bucket to v2.14.6, hotpatch with variant selector, 5% canary us-west for 30m. agree?
kevin: agree. hotpatch will be toggleable: RUNTIME_MATMUL_VARIANT=legacy. no ABI changes.
maria: pin command for ops: `deploybot pin --service runtime --version v2.14.6 --scope region:us-west --ttl 12h`
ana: Canary gates: 5xx <0.1%, 99p < baseline+15%, eviction-rate <=1.2x. auto-pin back on fail.
tom: QA will run perf harness + small prompt smoke.
maria: add RN note: "matmul kernel variant introduced; night bucket pinned to legacy due to thermal tail regressions; hotpatch pending." include rollback snippet.
kevin: rollback snippet: `deploybot pin --service runtime --version v2.14.6 --scope region:us-west --reason \"thermal regression\"` then `deploybot unpin --service runtime --scope region:us-west` when safe.
maria: timeline: pin in 10m, hotpatch in 40m, canary at +1h, decision at +2h. extend pin to 24h if hotpatch delayed.
nana: I'm oncall; I'll monitor dashboards and set alerts.
kevin: will enable per-op histograms after hotpatch deploy.
mar ia: status update at +30m. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: pinned runtime v2.14.6 in us-west (ttl 12h).
